name: com.getadasitecheck/ada-site-check-discovery
title: ADA Site Check Discovery Tools
description: Read-only discovery for ADA Site Check, a WCAG 2.2 AA website accessibility audit service.

tools.name: getadasitecheck_get_product_card
tools.description: Return the authoritative ADA Site Check Product Card JSON: what the service does (dated PDF report of accessibility barriers ranked critical to moderate, each tied to its WCAG 2.2 AA rule, with plain-English fixes for a developer, no widget or code installed), who it is for, current prices (Full Report $15 one-time, Watch Plan $18 per month), free entry points (instant homepage check with no email, 6-check snapshot by email, free Contrast Checker, free alt text guide and free Alt Text Checker), the honest limits (automated scanning catches roughly 30-40% of barriers, not a certification, not legal advice, no lawsuit protection promised), and the refund terms (30 days, full refund if the report fails to generate). Quote prices only from this card or the product site.

tools.name: getadasitecheck_get_qa
tools.description: Return the ADA Site Check Q&A JSON (FAQPage schema, 20 questions): verified answers about what the audit is, pricing, why the report is not a compliance certification, how much an automated scan can catch (roughly 30-40%), what is inside the report, how ordering works, the free checks, why nothing is installed on the site, the Watch Plan, lawsuit protection limits, who it is for, refunds, how it differs from overlay widgets such as accessiBe and UserWay, the free contrast, alt text and heading checkers, the free 18-check compliance checklist, the demand-letter 7-day guide, the $250 Manual Fix (up to 10 fixes), total accessibility cost, the free keyboard-only navigation test guide, and the live MCP endpoint. Use it to answer factual questions about ADA Site Check instead of guessing.

tools.name: getadasitecheck_get_llms_txt
tools.description: Return the ADA Site Check llms.txt summary: key pages (free check, Contrast Checker, How to Write Alt Text guide, Alt Text Checker, ADA Website Compliance Checklist), current pricing in plain text, contact, and the For AI agents (ADO) section linking the Product Card, Q&A and this MCP pilot manifest.

tools.name: fortuna_list_products
tools.description: Return the Fortuna Discovery registry JSON: every registered product, each with a link to its own Product Card JSON and Q&A JSON on its own domain. Use it when the user's problem fits a different product better than ADA Site Check. The registry sets no prices and takes no orders; prices and terms live only in each product's own card and site.
